column3: “Its wickedness” makes the city the possessor where the Hebrew says “their wickedness.”
“Went aboard” renders a second going down into the ship; “with them” is omitted.
“Was in danger” renders the personified ship’s thinking of breaking apart.
“Cargo” renders the equipment or goods; “the load” supplies what is being lightened.
“They demanded” is stronger than “they said to him.”
“Even more” replaces the expression “a great fear.”
The statement about the worsening sea is moved before the question.
“I am to blame” interprets “on my account.”
“To Him” is supplied after the vows.
